text:
A mobile fury warrior who builds rage through skill use.

Primary: STR | Secondary: DEX

MP mechanic: MP = Fury, generates from skill use even without mobs, decays when idle - release with Ragnarok for massive burst.

Skills:
Glaive Leap - 2-tile dash
Dragoon's Wrath - STR/DEX/speed self buff + bonus fury
Maelstrom - AoE all around
Valkyrie's Call - pull 4 mobs 2 tiles
Heaven's Recoil - push mobs 1 tile
Ragnarok - dump all fury for massive AoE burst, min 50 fury
